verdict.rationale: The firm's Executive Compensation page confirms it designs equity instruments (options, RSUs, restricted stock, SARs, phantom stock) with vesting/acceleration features, which covers general equity program design, but there is no mention of jurisdiction-specific schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs anywhere in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit description of UK EMI plans, German VSOP/ESOP structures, Indian ESOP schemes, or any cross-border equity plan design capability.
